A nuclear scar on farmland, rendered offline

Same blast, same seed, same real generated scar art and the real v14 crop sprite out of temperate.mix (24×24px). The only difference between the panels is the engine's pass order. The crop patch deliberately straddles the blast edge, so untouched fields of the same art sit a few cells away as a reference.

Today — terrain, smudge, actors

The fields are drawn after the smudge, so they hide it. This is the rectangular grid of untouched green inside the disc.

The change — … then smudge again, ground cover only

The same decal re-composited over the crop. The question is whether this reads as burnt ground or as crop under a dark wash — the scar art peaks at 78–93% coverage and never reaches full opacity, by design.
